83条目录含近战和特殊装备，60条有初速、54条有公布弹速曲线。名称映射、版本、: The 83 entries include melee and special equipment; 60 have muzzle speed and 54 have published speed curves. Names, versions, attachments and ammunition must match before use. Parameters from different builds stay separate.

头/颈/胸/腹/骨盆分别使用head、neck_01、spine_03、spin: Head/neck/chest/abdomen/pelvis use head, neck_01, spine_03, spine_01 and pelvis. Missing or ambiguous names are rejected. The legacy head-position fallback is only for head-only fixtures.
半角 %1°；距离上限 %2 m；合格 %3 人: Half-angle %1°; range limit %2 m; %3 eligible characters
排除自己、队友、缺队伍、缺部位和无效几何；通过角度与距离后优先最近，相同距离比角: Exclude self, teammates, missing team/aim-point data and invalid geometry. Within the angle and range limits, choose nearest first, then smaller angular error, then character ID. No health, weapon or visibility ranking is used.

原生组件速度；载具/附着增量按0: Native component velocity; parent/vehicle contribution assumed zero
本版实时适配使用原生MovementComponent速度，并按此前约定将载具/: This live adapter uses native MovementComponent velocity with extra parent/vehicle motion assumed zero, as previously requested. It is not proven total velocity. This is separate from bullet inheritance. Velocity must match the target's complete identity.

P当前 = P采样 + V × 数据年龄。源区间中点映射到本机时钟；年龄+误差≤: P_now = P_sample + V × sample age. Map the source interval midpoint to local time. Age + uncertainty ≤250 ms, uncertainty ≤25 ms, velocity sampling skew ≤100 ms, probe age ≤3000 ms. Failure never reuses old velocity. Bullet flight time is not included.
将相对位置R投影到相机forward/right/up；yaw误差=atan2(: Project R onto camera forward/right/up. Yaw error = atan2(R·right,R·forward); pitch error = atan2(R·up,hypot(R·forward,R·right)). The cone uses the angle to the forward axis.
yaw/count = 0.005 × 10^(S/50) × FOV/90；p: yaw/count = 0.005 × 10^(S/50) × FOV/90; pitch/count = sign × yaw/count × vertical multiplier. This is an input-response estimate, not a proven exact rule for every mode. Dynamic mode does not mix in measurements; measured-only mode requires a unique mode/FOV match.
按用户选择的模式及实时FOV匹配唯一实测yaw/pitch每计数角度，FOV容差: Match a unique measured yaw/pitch response using the chosen mode and live FOV, with 0.01° FOV tolerance. Missing or ambiguous records block output; the dynamic formula is not substituted.
Reader实时FOV；游戏输入设置与用户选择的当前模式。: Reader live FOV, game input settings and the mode selected by the user.
模式由用户指定，不靠FOV猜开镜状态；第三/第一人称用常规，瞄准用aim，开镜用: The user selects the mode; FOV does not infer ADS. Third/first person use general sensitivity, aim uses aim, ADS uses ads. Raw HID counts are not multiplied by DPI again. DPI scales learned limits and calibration context.
速度 %1 counts/s；加速 %2；制动 %3 counts/s²；单轴步: Speed %1 counts/s; acceleration %2; braking %3 counts/s²; step per axis ≤%4.
五档最高600/800/1600/2400/3200counts/s，步幅4/4: Five presets cap speed at 600/800/1600/2400/3200 counts/s and steps at 4/4/8/12/16, with at least 5 ms per update. An active learned model can lower these limits. Unsupported box capabilities block output. Holds have no five-second limit.
Ruckig短S曲线；jerk上限 %1 counts/s³。: Ruckig short S-curve; jerk limit %1 counts/s³.
根据剩余角度换算计数，按当前速度/加速度重规划限jerk轨迹，双轴相位同步；整数: Convert remaining angles to counts and replan a jerk-limited trajectory from current velocity/acceleration with phase-synchronised axes. Accumulate integer residuals, bounded by step and direction. Missing geometric/camera estimation uses a bounded proportional fallback. No player aim path is learned.
目标速度可用于20ms前向角差估算。: Target velocity is available for the 20 ms angular-rate estimate.
旧来源可使用有界骨点差分分支。: Legacy sources may use bounded aim-point differencing.
等待可靠当前速度；实时来源缺速时不改用旧差分。: Waiting for reliable current velocity; live sources do not fall back to legacy differencing.
用20ms前向位置的角差估算角速度，低于1°/s不前馈，终端计数速度限于上限90: Estimate angular rate from a 20 ms forward position. Ignore rates below 1°/s and cap terminal count velocity at 90% of the speed limit. Native prediction adds no legacy lookahead. Legacy differencing accepts 2–150 ms samples with 25 ms lookahead plus at most 35 ms local age. This is not bullet lead.
已启用模型；速度/加速/制动按DPI缩放后参与上限。: Model active; DPI-scaled speed/acceleration/braking constrain output.
未启用模型；仅载入或拟合不会参与输出。: No active model; loading or fitting alone does not affect output.
仅使用speed90、acceleration90、braking90，以DPI: Use only speed90, acceleration90 and braking90, scaled by DPI/1600 and capped by the preset. Aim accuracy, direction, residual paths and intentional shake are not learned.
已允许有界横向扰动；接近目标时归零。: Bounded lateral variation allowed; fades to zero near the target.
60ms更新的相关横向偏移，幅度有界约±0.2计数；角差≤0.6°时归零，不累计: Correlated lateral offset updated every 60 ms, bounded around ±0.2 counts. Zero at angular error ≤0.6°, without accumulated random walk. This variation is generated, not learned hand tremor.
按新相机姿态核对；最多256项或800ms未确认积压。: Reconcile new camera poses; at most 256 pending entries or 800 ms without confirmation.
把尚未体现在相机里的预计旋转从剩余误差中扣除，避免重复发送；响应相位只是估算，不: Subtract predicted rotations not yet reflected by the camera to avoid duplicate motion. Response phase is an estimate, not a per-command device ACK. Stop on unconfirmed camera progress. Recoil and manual motion are not definitive acknowledgements.
静止进入 %1°，离开 %2°；当前FOV缩放 %3。: Stationary enter %1°, leave %2°; current FOV scale %3.
静止目标在0.06°进入、0.12°离开稳定区，清速度、加速度、余量与微扰；动态: For stationary targets, enter the settled zone at 0.06° and leave at 0.12°; clear velocity, acceleration, residuals and variation. Dynamic mode scales thresholds by min(1,FOV/80). The 0.05° axis dead zone scales too. Angular feedforward keeps moving targets tracked.
当前没有输出；链路就绪后仍须物理侧键触发。: No current output; a physical side-button press is required even when the link is ready.
Reader请求与盒子连接后自动待命；侧键回传需≤150ms且能力有效。松键停止: Stand by automatically after a Reader request and box connection. Button feedback must be ≤150 ms old with valid capabilities. Release or a scheduling gap >30 ms stops motion. Capture/calibration/desktop tests are exclusive. Bounded serial steps, configuration generations and firmware release gating remain in effect. No automatic firing.
未参与；当前只补数据年龄，不预测飞行期间目标位置。: Not included; only sample age is predicted, not target motion during bullet flight.
尚未求解 B(τ)=E(t发射+τ)，没有输出飞行时间或预测命中残差；不能把20: B(τ)=E(t_fire+τ) is not yet solved. There is no flight-time or predicted-impact residual output. The 20 ms control feedforward and network-age prediction are not bullet lead.
未建模；数据年龄补偿按短时恒速平移。: Not modelled; sample-age prediction assumes short-term constant translation.
未加入目标加速度、突然转向预测或头部相对身体的动画速度；身体速度平移不是完整骨点: No target acceleration, sudden-turn prediction or head animation velocity relative to the body. Translating by body velocity does not predict the complete future bone path.
未使用枪械压枪曲线、随机弹散布、风或空气密度。: No weapon recoil pattern, random bullet spread, wind or air-density model.
当前控制代码未包含这些弹道模型。: These ballistic models are absent from current control.
